items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Because I was asking for instance, Ed Garland... And I asked him if he was conscious of the chords... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I, there's lots of guys can do that.

ctx.x: No, no, that was in the mind. Yes, yeah. A little mind.

Because I was asking for instance, Ed Garland, in playing his bass, in which he doesn't have the same problem quite as you playing the chords. No. But they do play chords on the bass too, you know. Oh yes. And I asked him if he was conscious of the chords as he played them and he said no, hardly ever. He said I could be talking to somebody. And he'd be playing his bass and yet his fingers would find the right chords on any piece that he knew. He never, as he knew a piece, he never thought of what chord he or even…
Well, I, there's lots of guys can do that.
